svg.title: Clariceptify | Release 1 | Complete conceptual model | Review candidate
svg.desc: All 137 concepts and 296 relationships from the review-candidate specification. Human scientific acceptance and native OntoUML validation are not established.
svg.text: R1 REVIEW CANDIDATE | 137 concepts | 174 associations | 122 generalizations | 20 subject domains + Foundations | diagram-r1.1 | 25 October 2026
Complete vector view; zoom required. Domain colors are not stereotypes. Scientific acceptance not established; native OntoUML validation not assessed.

svg.text: DOMAIN COLOURS, DEFINITIONS AND CONCEPT COUNTS

g.text: The formation and articulation of an explicit, purpose-oriented account of a subject.
The goal-directed orientation of agents and the content guiding their choices.
Mental activities and states involved in attending to, interpreting and understanding a subject.
The selection of relevant characteristics and organization of descriptions across levels of generality.
Meaning, interpretation and conditions for compatible understanding of representations.
Descriptions of connections and attributed characteristics among conceptual elements.
Forms and conventions through which conceptual content is externally expressed.
Activities and artifacts that express selected aspects of a subject as structured models.
Organization of conceptual elements, including part-whole descriptions.
Systems and activities for expressing and communicating content through signs and rules.
Terms, definitions and their systematic organization for a selected subject.
Models and activities that describe modeling constructs and classification levels.
Formation, application and hierarchical organization of conceptual categories.
Formal expression, adopted assertions and restrictions on admissible interpretations.
Explicit assumptions about the entities and relations admitted in a conceptual account.
General categories of being, state, change and temporal organization relevant to a subject.
Articulable content about a subject that can inform understanding and conceptual choices.
Criteria for judging the semantic adequacy and internal integrity of conceptual artifacts.
Activities and explicit criteria used to examine conceptual artifacts.
Origins, supporting information and assumptions associated with conceptual content.
A cross-domain support layer of general categories required for UFO-grounded typing.

svg.text: Solid line: association, navigability unspecified. Hollow triangle: generalization pointing to the supertype; no multiplicities on generalizations.
Association multiplicities count instances at their own class end. Crossings are not junctions. Fine grey leaders attach moved labels to their original locations.
Generalizations may share a hollow parent arrowhead. Shared arrowheads assert neither disjointness nor completeness of the subclasses.
Concept, Relation, Property and Instance are information descriptions. Relation is not automatically a UFO relator; part-whole descriptions do not assert UML composition.
Coverage and connector checks passed. Formal OntoUML/UFO satisfiability and expert semantic validation remain open. Read the specification for the 24 semantic constraints.
Notation reference: OntoUML Vocabulary v1.1.1 (https://dev.ontouml.org/ontouml-vocabulary/). Generalization and association use UML connector conventions.
